symptom: API gateway returning 502s (~41%) for 6 minutes during peak traffic; gateway pod CPU pegged at 100%.
root_cause: HPA maxReplicas was still at the pre-launch default of 4, so gateway pods were CPU-throttled and dropped upstream connections.
resolution: `kubectl scale deployment/api-gateway --replicas=12` to recover immediately, then `kubectl patch hpa api-gateway --type merge -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'` to raise the ceiling.

03:39:40Z hpa/api-gateway currentReplicas=4 desiredReplicas=11 maxReplicas=4 (capped)
03:40:05Z api-gateway-3 cpu=1.00/1.00 cfs_throttled_periods=98%

symptom: Checkout intermittently timing out at the payment step; error rate ~8%, no regional pattern.
root_cause: A newly deployed retry loop never released DB connections on failure, exhausting the payments connection pool.
resolution: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout-service`, then patched the connection-release bug before redeploying.
logs: 14:03:51Z checkout-service ERROR HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
14:03:51Z checkout-service WARN pool stats total=50 active=50 idle=0 waiting=37
14:04:20Z payments-db INFO connections=198/200

symptom: Mobile checkout failing with SSL handshake errors; payments-api certificate had expired. Success rate down ~60%.
root_cause: cert-manager renewal had been failing silently for 12 days after the ACME solver ingress class was renamed.
resolution: `kubectl cert-manager renew payments-api-tls -n payments` to force reissue, then corrected the ingress class on the Issuer.

22:09:05Z ingress-nginx WARN SSL_do_handshake() failed (SSL: error:0A000086) client=mobile-app
22:10:40Z cert-manager ERROR Failed to determine ingress class for solver: class 'nginx-public' not found

symptom: Redis memory climbing until OOM kill, recurring every ~6 minutes; cache-dependent services degrade on each restart.
root_cause: A config change removed the default TTL, so session cache keys were written without expiry and grew unbounded until Redis hit its memory limit.
resolution: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redis-cache` to restore the config with TTLs, then flushed the unbounded keys with `redis-cli --scan --pattern 'session:*' | xargs -L 1000 redis-cli del`.
logs: 02:09:41Z redis-cache-0 WARN used_memory=3.81GB maxmemory=4GB eviction_policy=noeviction
02:11:02Z redis-cache-0 ERROR OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'
02:11:03Z kubelet Killing container redis-cache reason=OOMKilled exitCode=137

symptom: Postgres primary went read-only with 'No space left on device'; writes failing across services.
root_cause: WAL archiving to object storage stalled after an IAM key rotation, so pg_wal filled the 500GB data volume.
resolution: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/wal-archiver` after updating the rotated credential secret; archiver drained the backlog and space recovered.
logs: 11:27:18Z postgres-0 PANIC could not write to file pg_wal/xlogtemp.88: No space left on device
11:24:02Z wal-archiver ERROR upload failed: AccessDenied (InvalidAccessKeyId)
11:28:00Z node-exporter WARN filesystem /var/lib/postgresql usage=100%

symptom: Consumer lag on the orders topic grew past 2M messages; consumers crash-looping and rebalancing endlessly.
root_cause: A poison-pill message with malformed protobuf crashed the consumer on every attempt, blocking its partition.
resolution: `kubectl exec kafka-0 -- kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 --group orders-consumer --topic orders:3 --reset-offsets --shift-by 1 --execute` to skip the poison message, then added a dead-letter queue.
logs: 16:44:09Z orders-consumer-2 ERROR InvalidProtocolBufferException: Protocol message contained an invalid tag
16:44:10Z orders-consumer-2 WARN Consumer group rebalance in progress (generation 4127)
16:47:31Z kafka-exporter INFO consumergroup_lag{topic=orders,partition=3}=1984221

symptom: search-service pods OOMKilled roughly every 20 minutes starting right after the morning deploy.
root_cause: Release v2.14 introduced an unbounded in-memory result cache that grew until the container memory limit was hit.
resolution: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/search-service` to restore v2.13; the cache bound was fixed in v2.15.

09:16:02Z kubelet Killing container search-service reason=OOMKilled exitCode=137
09:12:00Z argocd INFO Sync completed: search-service v2.14 (started 09:11)

symptom: Intermittent 'no such host' errors between internal services; CoreDNS pods pinned at 100% CPU.
root_cause: A chatty new service combined with the default ndots:5 setting multiplied DNS queries roughly 10x, overwhelming under-provisioned CoreDNS.
resolution: `kubectl scale deployment/coredns -n kube-system --replicas=6`, then lowered ndots in the new service's pod spec.

13:02:30Z coredns-7d9 WARN plugin/ready: timeout awaiting response, cpu=1.00/1.00
13:03:02Z coredns-metrics INFO coredns_dns_requests_total rate=48k/s (baseline 5k/s)

symptom: Background job queue backing up; jobs processing ~10x slower than normal with no errors in logs.
root_cause: A typo in a cron expression made report-sync submit duplicate jobs every minute instead of every hour.
resolution: `kubectl patch cronjob report-sync -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`, purged duplicate queue entries, then corrected the schedule to `0 * * * *`.

09:12:01Z report-sync INFO enqueued job report-sync-20260624-0912
09:13:00Z report-sync INFO enqueued job report-sync-20260624-0913

symptom: Read replicas ~9 minutes behind the primary; dashboards and reports showing stale data.
root_cause: A long-running analytics query held a snapshot that blocked WAL replay on the replica.
resolution: Terminated the offending session with `psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' AND now()-query_start > interval '30 minutes'"`, then moved analytics to a dedicated replica.
